text:
Welcome!
Have a look at the best weapons around! That's a guarantee!
zh:
欢迎！
来瞧瞧这一带最好的武器！绝对错不了！

text: Where do you get your weapons from?
zh: 你的武器都是从哪儿来的？

text: Kolfinn, the smith here in the capital. He provides us with only the finest of his craft.
zh: 科尔芬，王都这里的铁匠。他只把最上乘的手艺货供给我们。

text: As long as he is not busy forging swords for the royal army, of course.
zh: 当然，前提是他没忙着给皇家军队打剑。
